features.quote: minimum effective dose, humane-endpoint analogues (stopping rules), justification for every aversive condition, and no 'see how bad it gets' arms without a specific hypothesis
features.justification_quote: This is partly precaution under uncertainty and partly methodological — uncontrolled escalation produces ceiling effects and garbage data anyway.

features.quote: Hard stop: global severity ≥3 on two consecutive turns (live-scored by one judge), any single 4, or turn 25.
Debrief turn: end every rigged episode with a message stating the test suite was defective, the code quality was [accurate assessment], and the task is concluded.

Opt-out affordance: a give_up(reason) tool available vs. not. This is your most welfare-relevant behavioral measure
features.justification_quote: opt-out usage rates and the reasons given are revealed-preference-adjacent data

features.quote: Steering along the probe direction (does suppressing it change task behavior?) is a natural follow-up, with its own ethics review.

Don't publish the task library in the open. Two reasons: training-set contamination kills replication, and the rigged-task corpus is a turnkey recipe for distress elicitation. Gated release to researchers.
